notes: Campaign spells (Tools > Spells): pick which of spells 1-6 to cast while pushing the campaign, Tap or Drag for each, and draw the area drags land in (random spot inside). Only casts when ready -- not on cooldown, not blue (no mana), not while a stay-on spell is still on. Wasteland: collects the Ticket Usher's tickets and/or the Elixir Generator's elixir when the World Map shows them ready (Collect in Wasteland: Tickets / Elixir).
